review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Key Responsibilities Install, configure and administer SAP S/4HANA 2023 systems on SAP HANA Plan and execute upgrades, conversions and patching with SUM, SPAM/SAINT and Maintenance Planner (SPS, kernel and HANA revisions) Manage the transport landscape (STMS, CTS+) and release transports to QAS and PRD Administer SAP HANA: backup and recovery, memory and CPU monitoring, parameter tuning and System Replication Monitor system health and performance (SM21, ST22, SM50/SM66, ST03N, DBACOCKPIT) and solve issues Manage users, roles and authorizations together with the security team (SU01, PFCG, SUIM) Configure and support RFC, IDoc and web-service connectivity (SM59, WE02, SICF) Set up and support Fiori Front-end Server, SAP Gateway, Web Dispatcher and SAP router Schedule and monitor background jobs (SM36/SM37) Perform client copies, system refreshes and system copies Support SAP BTP and Succes
